words.explanation: vi. if business, trade, or a particular area is booming, it is very successful 繁荣；迅速发展
words.example: Business is booming and foreigners are coming to invest.

words.explanation: n. [C] sb. who is paid by actors, musicians, etc. to find work for them 代理人；经纪人
v. to discuss sth. in order to reach an agreement, esp. in business or politics 谈判；协商；商定
words.example: Union leaders have negotiated an agreement for a shorter working day.

words.explanation: n. [C] sb. who has general control of the preparation of a play, movie, broadcast, etc., but who does not direct the actors 制作人；制片人
a. ( not before noun ) very excited, happy, and pleased 非常激动的；幸福的；高兴的
words.example: He was thrilled when the teacher asked him to read his poem in class.

words.explanation: n. [C] the written form of a speech, play, movie, etc. 演说稿；讲稿；剧本
n. [C, U] an old, well-known story, often about brave people, adventures, or magical events 传说；传奇（故事）
vt. to gain an amount as a total profit, or earn it as a total amount, before taxes have been subtracted 获得…的总利润/毛利/税前收入
words.example: The new action movie grossed over 100 million dollars at the box office.

words.explanation: vt. to choose which people will act particular parts in a play, movie, etc. 为…挑选演员
words.example: She was so glad that she was cast as the leading character in the play.

words.explanation: n. [C] sth. that is impossible to understand or explain or about which little is known 神秘的事物；谜
words.example: The main actor of the new movie is still a mystery to the public.

words.explanation: a. ( only before noun ) relating to sb. who boxes or wrestles in the heaviest weight group 重量级的
n. [C] a person, team, etc. that has won a competition, esp. in sports 冠军；第一名
n. [C] sb. who fights as a sport; boxer 拳击手
ad. mistakenly or unreasonably, esp. in action or behavior 错误地；不明智地
words.example: Some people are misguidedly asking for more payment than is reasonable.

words.explanation: n. [sing.] used to describe how successful a movie, play, or actor is, by the number of people who pay to see them 票房（价值）
vt. to be even better or greater than sb. or sth. else 超过；胜过
words.example: In a few years, China will likely surpass the US as the world's largest movie market.

words.explanation: n. ( or ~s ) [sing.] a movie company or the buildings it owns and uses to make its movies 电影制片公司；电影制片厂
n. [C] ( infml. ) a book or movie that is very good or successful 轰动一时的电影/书籍
words.example: The new film can be seen as another blockbuster.

words.explanation: n. [C, U] sth. that you receive because you have done sth. good or helpful 报答；报偿；酬谢；奖赏
words.example: She worked hard without any hope of reward.

words.explanation: a. done with a lot of energy and determination 猛烈的；热烈的；激烈的
words.example: The following round of questions for the minister was fast and furious.

words.explanation: n. [C, U] a funny movie, television program, play, etc. that makes people laugh, or this type of entertainment 喜剧
n. [C] an imaginary sea creature that has the upper body of a woman and a fish's tail 美人鱼
n. [C, usu. pl.] sb. who goes to the cinema to see a film（去电影院）看电影的人
a. happening without being planned or intended 偶然的；意外的
words.example: It's reported that the fire was not accidental.

words.explanation: n. [C, U] the opportunity to experience ideas, events, methods, etc. that are new to you 接触；体验
words.example: Exposure to a second language should take place at an early age.

words.explanation: n. [C] sb. who is not accepted as a member of a particular social group 局外人；外人
n. [C] a general tendency in the way a situation is changing or developing 趋势；趋向；倾向
words.example: If current trends continue, tourism in this country will increase by 12% this year.

words.explanation: vi. to risk going somewhere when it could be dangerous 冒风险；冒险（去某处）
words.example: I take my dog with me when I venture into a new place.

words.explanation: n. [C] a man who operates a camera to film movies or television programs（电影或电视节目的）摄影师
vi. to work with sb. else to achieve sth. that you both want 合作；协作
words.example: We're cooperating to achieve common goals.

words.explanation: n. [C] sb. or sth. that has the same job or purpose as sb. or sth. else in a different place 地位/职务相当的人/物
words.example: The foreign minister held talks with his Chinese counterpart.

words.explanation: used to say that sth. is much better, worse, etc. than anything else 最；无疑；很
words.example: This is by far the best news I have heard today.

words.explanation: to arrive, esp. at the place where sb. is waiting for you 露面，来到（尤指有人在等候之处）
words.example: It's unnecessary to wait in the airport, for the superstar won't show up.

words.explanation: for a fairly short time, until sth. happens to change the situation 有一段较短的时间
words.example: We were quite happy for a time, until our neighbor moved in.

words.explanation: to cause another thing to happen or exist 导致；有利于
words.example: Happy parents make for a happy child.

words.explanation: if sb. plays by their own rules or makes other people play by their rules, they set the conditions for doing business or having a relationship 按某人定的规矩行事
words.example: You know how we do business here, and I expect you to play by our rules in the future.

words.explanation: 乔纳森・科斯– 瑞德（1973-, 中文名“曹操”，美国演员）
布鲁斯・李（1940-1973, 即李小龙，华人功夫明星）
迈克・泰森（1966-, 美国著名拳击手）
蒙台梭利（1870-1952, 意大利教育家）
好莱坞（美国著名影城，常用来代指电影业）
